newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela higher reserve requirement starts Aug 11.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela higher reserve requirement starts Aug 11.

text.p: Venezuela's 17 percent reserve requirement for commercial banks will take effect August 11, a Central Bank official told Reuters on Monday.
The Central Bank announced earlier that it was raising the reserve requirement to 17 percent from 15 percent, with the extra two percentage point deposit bearing interest.
The first 15 percentage points of the reserve requirement is held in a non-interest bearing account at the Central Bank.
The increase in the reserve requirement -- the second in less than a month -- had been widely expected on money markets as the Central Bank steps up efforts to drain excess liquidity.
